releases.title: Restore download display and correct connection checks
changes: Prevent cached JavaScript from hiding downloads: version all local scripts/styles with each release, revalidate local assets, and keep file rows visible if sorting is unavailable.
Check the authenticated device session before diagnosing account failure. Retry PC discovery independently and label cached or unavailable discovery accurately.
Separate display errors from connection errors and keep optional logging/history storage failures from blocking live download status.

releases.title: Keep closed Settings clear during delayed loads
changes: Prevent delayed settings requests from repopulating masked secrets after the popup closes; verify saved values reload on reopening.

releases.title: Utility hub, persistent setup and server insights
changes: Center Changes, Download, Open JDownloader App, Siri-Shortcut and History controls; show social logo images beside a larger brand and version.
Keep all connection controls in Settings, reload saved masked/revealable values, add input help, Step by Step guidance and layered connection testing.
Save browser-local download presets, warn about recorded or pending duplicate links, show backend upload-disk space and sort downloads.
Persist per-device server link/completion history and observed download statistics; keep unknown metrics explicit.
Add opt-in persistent system logs with viewer, JSON download and clear controls; recording starts disabled.
Document pending work and 50 potential future features; retain all earlier release notes.

releases.title: Creator links and public frontend publishing
changes: Add Created by Jamie Reddin and labelled GitHub, Discord, X and Reddit buttons to the footer.
Keep the README title synchronized with the release version.
Prepare a frontend-only public repository on the frontend-pages branch, while the complete app stays in a separate private repository.

releases.title: Verified release-note retry
changes: Correct the version-specific retry test fixture and verify the full settings and download regression suites.

releases.title: Release-note retry regression check
changes: Keep release-note retry checks reliable when the installed app version changes.

releases.title: Portable release verification
changes: Make source verification portable across Windows, macOS and Linux and include workflow/dependency changes in release checks.
Clarify that signed Shortcut downloads are produced by successful GitHub Actions runs.

releases.title: Persistent settings and desktop tools
changes: Edit account and server settings in a popup; save privately on the backend machine across sessions.
Generate a secure random access token and use a persistent HTTPS backend address for a separately hosted frontend.
Request JDownloader desktop launch on the backend PC and open OS-aware official installer options.
Prepare GitHub Actions checks, versioned packaging and Pages frontend deployment; Pages currently requires an eligible plan for this private repository.
Add a versioned Shortcut draft with installation setup question, a macOS signing attempt and optional published iCloud installation link.

releases.title: Versioned releases and Changes
changes: The footer shows the app version.
Changes opens a scrollable release history with dates and version numbers.
Release packaging uses V1.0.0-jd-share.zip naming and checks that app edits include a version update.
Earlier feature summaries are retained as unversioned history.

releases.title: Devices, speed limits, schedules and sharing
changes: Choose a JDownloader PC; reviews, selections and observed history stay tied to its device.
Discover supported speed-limit settings and save one-time server controller schedules.
Send an explicit resume/retry request for an unfinished file.
Use the iPhone Shortcut setup guide to open shared links for manual review. Actual phone setup and live feature checks remain pending.

releases.title: Organise Downloads and manage selections
changes: Group Downloads into collapsible packages and combine status filters with filename search.
Apply Enable, Disable or Priority to selected unfinished files.
Choose a destination for new links.
Opt into local observed-completion history and notifications while the page is open.

releases.title: Enable recovery verified
changes: Enable stays available when JDownloader does not return an enabled state.
A live test confirmed that an explicit Enable request restored the test file to Enabled.

releases.title: Per-file controls and mobile layout
changes: Manage individual unfinished downloads and change priority.
Refresh the dark/amber layout, improve long filename wrapping and simplify global controls.
Show the chosen upload filename and size, with separate upload feedback.
Keep connection settings tucked away behind Settings.

releases.title: Downloads and LinkGrabber tabs
changes: Browse pending LinkGrabber files, search names and select which files move to Downloads.
Keep selections across searches and show hidden-selection counts.
Reject expired, missing or already-used selections before moving files.

releases.title: Download visibility and connection feedback
changes: Display progress, loaded size, speed, ETA and queue counts.
Keep last-known cards during a connection failure and hide stale speed/ETA.
Show clearer token, connection and timeout feedback.

releases.title: Review files before downloading
changes: Find files lists detected results without automatically selecting them.
Move only chosen results to Downloads and leave other results in LinkGrabber.
Keep Add only and phone-to-PC uploads available.
